title: Gintama': Enchousen
synopsis:
While Gintoki Sakata was away, the Yorozuya found themselves a new leader: Kintoki, Gintoki's golden-haired doppelganger. In order to regain his former position, Gintoki will need the help of those around him, a troubling feat when no one can remember him! Between Kintoki and Gintoki, who will claim the throne as the main character?

In addition, Yorozuya make a trip back down to red-light district of Yoshiwara to aid an elderly courtesan in her search for her long-lost lover. Although the district is no longer in chains beneath the earth's surface, the trio soon learn of the tragic backstories of Yoshiwara's inhabitants that still haunt them. With flashback after flashback, this quest has Yorozuya witnessing everlasting love and protecting it as best they can with their hearts and souls.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

The fake Gintama continues to butt in on Odd Job Kin-chan, yet the people are

episodes_data.description: Kintoki has railed the city to search for Gin, but a few leaders question why he is obsessing over one man.

episodes_data.title: The Meaning of a Main Character
episodes_data.description: The battle of Kin-chan vs. Gin-Chan reaches the climax.  Kin-Chan will end this anime for good this time.

episodes_data.title: Courtesan Turns the Tables
episodes_data.description: After being invited to spend the night with the legendary Courtesan, Gin must fight back the waves of nausea and help this woman see the next moon rise.

episodes_data.title: Inside the Palace!!
episodes_data.description: The current Shogun is unconscious and the former shogun it outside the door requesting an audience. Gin must play the role of Shigeshige or everyone will lose their head.

episodes_data.title: Five Pinkies
episodes_data.description: The Odd Jobs team and Tsu-Ki assault the palace with full force.  Things are going well until the Oniwabanshu appears to protect the former shogun.

episodes_data.title: Pinky Swear
episodes_data.description:
It seems every faction has turned against the former shogun Sadasada.  With the help of a friend Gin is given a second chance to defeat Oboro, but will his body hold out?  Can he 
keep his promise to Tsu-ki?

episodes_data.title: Unsetting Moon
episodes_data.description: The former shogun is gone and change is coming, but who were the real victors?  And what of the promise made under the full moon?

episodes_data.title: The Sound of a Beam Can Pierce Every Heart
episodes_data.description: Otae has new determination to restore her family’s dojo and luckily a former student has come back to town.

episodes_data.title: Two Brothers
episodes_data.description: Gintoki has taken it upon himself to be the bad guy, so nobody will have to be hurt.

episodes_data.title: Liquor and Gasoline, Smiles and Tears
episodes_data.description:
Gintoki insistence on saving Hajime has caused him to get badly hurt.  This match will be decided between Obi Hajime of the School of Beam Saber and Shimura Shinpachi of the 
School of Tendo Mushin.
